info.title: API.SH: AbeBooks
info.description: The AbeBooks API from API.SH: public AbeBooks data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The AbeBooks page of one ISBN: title, author, publisher, publication date, language, binding, page count, description, cover, reader rating and number of ratings, the lowest used and new price with the number of copies of each, the edition details, and the top offers (price, shipping, quantity, condition description, seller name, location and rating, listing id). Use /abebooks/v1/search with `isbn` for every copy.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/abebooks-book

parameters.name: isbn
parameters.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (hyphens allowed), or an AbeBooks ISBN page link.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Regional store (default com).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One AbeBooks listing (a specific copy for sale): title, authors, illustrator, publisher, year, edition, binding, language, ISBNs, condition, the seller's full description, attributes (first edition, signed, jacket condition...), price, shipping and delivery-time options, quantity, all photos, series, synopsis, about-the-title text, bibliographic details, page count, number of other offers, the seller's terms of sale and shipping terms, and the seller (name, location, star rating, member since, business name and address, about text, payment methods). A listing that has sold or was removed answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/abebooks-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (`items[].id` from search), or an AbeBooks listing link.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Regional store for prices and language (default: the link's store, else com).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The cheapest new and the cheapest used copy of an ISBN on AbeBooks: price, shipping to the store's country, condition, short description, seller id and country, listing id and link, international-edition flag, and the number of new, used and total copies, plus first-edition and binding counts. A quick price check without the full listing data.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/abebooks-prices

parameters.name: isbn
parameters.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (hyphens allowed).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Regional store: prices in its currency, shipping to its country (default com).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
New, used, rare and collectible books (and magazines, comics, sheet music, art, photos, maps and manuscripts) for sale by independent booksellers on AbeBooks, with every filter of the search page: keywords, title, author, publisher, ISBN, seller, product type, condition, binding, first edition, signed, dust jacket, seller photos, not print-on-demand, free shipping, price and publication-year ranges, minimum seller rating, and 12 sort orders. Each listing has title, authors, publisher, year, edition, binding, language, ISBNs, condition (site and seller wording), the seller's description, attributes, price, shipping and delivery-time options, quantity, photos, series, seller (id, name, city, region, country, star rating, storefront link) and the lowest new/used price for that ISBN. `facets` gives the counts per filter value. `site` picks the regional store (prices in its currency, text in its language). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (first 10,000 matches).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/abebooks-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (title, author, description). One of q, title, author, publisher, isbn or seller_id is required.

parameters.description: Words in the title.

parameters.description: Author or contributor name.

parameters.name: publisher
parameters.description: Publisher name.

parameters.name: isbn
parameters.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (hyphens allowed): every copy of that edition.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: A seller's id (from `seller.id` or a storefront link): only that seller's listings.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Kind of item.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition group: new, any used, as new/fine/near fine, very good/good, fair/poor, or as described by the seller.

parameters.name: binding
parameters.description: Binding.

parameters.name: first_edition
parameters.description: Only first editions.

parameters.name: signed
parameters.description: Only signed copies.

parameters.name: dust_jacket
parameters.description: Only copies with a dust jacket.

parameters.name: seller_images
parameters.description: Only listings with the seller's own photos.

parameters.name: no_print_on_demand
parameters.description: Leave out print-on-demand copies.

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: Only listings with free shipping to the store's country.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the store's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, in the store's currency.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Published in or after this year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Published in or before this year.

parameters.name: min_seller_rating
parameters.description: Minimum seller star rating (2-5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order. Default relevance (recent when only seller_id is given).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Regional store (default com, US dollars).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Listings per page (1-50, default 30).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A bookseller's AbeBooks storefront: name, status, member since, star rating and score, location, trading address, registered business name and address, about text, associations, catalogs, billing currency, terms of sale, shipping terms, current promotions, the most recently listed items, and search links for the seller's first editions and signed books. List every item with /abebooks/v1/search?seller_id=.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/abebooks-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Seller id (`seller.id` from a listing), or a storefront link.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Regional store (default: the link's store, else com).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
